comment: One row for each check that keeps a residual fort target of a call free of
graph edges and fact flow, and one for the explicit flow beside it (D17.18).
A row names the line that holds the check and the text that breaks it. The
module tests compile src/fort with the mutant. The table runs on a darwin
host with --runner 'bash -c' after cmake --preset debug. ZERO_AR_DATE=1
makes the darwin link reproducible, so the md5 guard holds.

stages.name: graph module tests
